title: Central Omega Resources Reports 140% Nickel Production Surge and 38% Net Profit Growth in H1 2025
body: PT Central Omega Resources Tbk reported a 140.3% jump in nickel ore production to 1.73 Mt and a 158.9% rise in sales to 1.83 Mt in H1 2025, driving total sales to Rp950.7 bn and net profit to Rp310.3 bn (+38.2%) while EBITDA surged 218.7% to Rp481.4 bn. The company attributes the performance to full‑scale mining operations resumed after a new 2024 RKAB, and remains optimistic for 2025 amid stable global nickel prices, though it remains wary of potential US tariff uncertainties.

title: Indonesia's Nickel Prices Rise in Early October 2025, APNI Highlights Need for Market‑Reflective Adjustments
body: The Indonesian Nickel Association (APNI) announced that nickel prices rose to US$15,101.67 per dmt in the first half of October 2025, up from US$15,000.33 in mid‑September, citing the HMA reference price formula. APNI also detailed price tiers for different nickel grades and moisture contents—e.g., 1.60% grade at 30% MC priced at US$28.75 per wmt, 1.90% at 30% MC at US$40.17 per wmt, and 2.00% grades above US$40 per wmt—while urging the government to adjust prices to better reflect market realities for low‑grade domestic miners.

title: Merdeka Battery's Nickel Ore Production Surges 78% in H1 2025 While Revenue Falls 32%
body: In the first half of 2025, Merdeka Battery's PT Sulawesi Cahaya Mineral mine produced 6.9 million wet metric tons of nickel ore, a 78% year‑on‑year jump driven by 45% growth in limonit and 189% in saprolit, even as extreme weather tested operations. Despite a 32% revenue decline to US$628 million, the company’s downstream output of nickel pig iron fell 23% to 33,045 t but its cash cost dropped below US$10,000/ton, while MHP sales reached 9,465 t and new feed‑prep plants and slurry pipelines are slated for completion by mid‑2026, supporting a robust EBITDA of US$77 million.
